advisories.title: Align the issued-document action names with the implemented surface
advisories.body: The action table calls the issuance operations `issueDecision` and `issueContract`, but the task specification and implementation expose the persisted operations as `exportDecision` and `exportContract`. Using the actual names in this contract prevents a future maintainer from looking for nonexistent actions or introducing duplicate wrappers.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:407-408 names `issueDecision` and `issueContract` → Improvement: one action vocabulary makes the technical contract searchable and unambiguous → Fix: rename those two table entries to `exportDecision` and `exportContract`, retaining their described issuance behavior.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_03.md:52 → the task explicitly identifies the existing `exportDecision` and `exportContract` actions as the issuance surface to evolve.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:491,741 → the exported server-action symbols are `exportDecision` and `exportContract`; no `issueDecision` or `issueContract` action exists.
